notes.title: Dead Detention Version 1.5
notes.notes:
Version 1.5 of Dead Detention is out now! It features improved Gamepad controls, a new unlockable extra, QOL updates, and lots more! It's also 70% off for the next two weeks!

This will be the final major update for the game (though I'll continue to fix any bugs or issues that pop up, of course), so I've gone through and updated the Steam page to show what the game looks like now, too.
[previewyoutube="Q3t8cPP7--8;full"][/previewyoutube]Patch NotesRedesigned Microgames for Gamepads
Almost all the microgames have had tweaks and redesigns to make them work as well with Gamepad buttons and joysticks as they do with a mouse.
Other Microgame Improvements
Improved Clarity

Some small adjustments were made to some microgames to make their objectives more readable at a glance:

Episode 1 and 2: Added a spinning baseball bat to the touch all icons microgame + changed the moving icons microgame to be similar.

Episode 5: Added the correct answer faintly to the background in the puzzle microgame.

Episode 5: The press 3 times microgame now shows HP numbers.

Episode 5: The phone dial microgame now is a pointing finger instead of a triangle.

Episode 5: Moved the Pac microgame spawn point slightly up so it doesn't instantly hit an icon.

Episode 5: The running icon microgame now shows the goal color spinning and at a smaller size. Also, two of the same color are now never shown at the same time.

The instructions for bosses now stay on screen until the player presses to continue.

Balancing

The Rhythm Minigame: Lives are less common in Normal mode.

Adjusted lots of time limits, taking the new versions into account.

Misc

Improved the zombie punching sprite in the boxing minigame.
Microgame Marathon
A new extra has been added that's unlocked by completing episode 5: Microgame Marathon.

In this mode, you play through all the microgames in order from start to finish, which the background and music changing to fit the episode.
Max's Exercise Book
Added Max's cut-up exercise book opening up to the intro of Episode 1.

Added the book closing to the outro of the Epilogue.
Improved Art
Scribbles

Episode 1: Improved the blackboard scribbles.

Episode 1: Fixed Naomi's bar scribble being slightly over the edge.

Episode 1: Improved the equipping items scribbles.

Episode 1: Improved the fire-starting scribbles.

Episode 2: Improved the teacher firing her bow scribble.

Episode 3: Improved Sora defeating ??? scribble.

Episode 4: Improved the hiding in locker scribble.

Character Poses & Arts and Crafts Theming

Max

Moved Max's sad equip pose onto grid paper, and made it drawn in ballpoint pen.

Changed some of Max's other equipping poses to grey pencil.

Made his shade pose slightly desaturated.

Dr. Miller

Moved her shade pose onto a cardboard texture.

Moved her frown pose onto blue colored paper.

Dr. Okaby

Moved his sigh pose onto newspaper.

Ryan

Moved his crying pose onto blue paper.

Naomi

Moved her laughing pose onto cardboard.

Changed her ":/" pose to a taped-on sticker.

Lowered her height slightly to keep it more consistent with the scribbles.

Moved her crying pose onto blue paper.

Ms. White

Moved her anger pose onto red colored paper.

Moved her chalk pose onto cardboard.

Sora

Made her eyes angry when holding the bat.

Made her face :3 when playing DS or using her phone.

Improved the outlines on her ":/" pose.

Substitute Teacher

Moved her anger pose onto red paper.
Improved Story
Script

Improved lots of dialogue.

Punched up and added a few jokes.

Cut some of the weaker jokes.

Smoothed out some slight plot holes.

Sequencing

Lots of small improvements were made across many scenes, such as additional sounds or screen shakes.
Other Updates
General Clarity and QOL

If you're playing on Easy or Normal difficulty, you can now toggle between them anytime from the pause menu. (This won't affect any achievements or unlocks.)

Added a Plot Tokens explanation to the Choices window.

Added a note at the start of the game saying keyboard controls aren't recommended.

Menus

The screen now fades out before entering the Boss Rush.

Improved the exclamation icon on the extras button.

Bug Fixes

Fixed the atmosphere volume only updating on load.

Thanks so much for playing my dumb little game! It's improved and grown so much since that initial launch version back in 2024 - I kinda wish I held back on release until now! 😅 But that's how I always feel, I guess...

This was so much fun to make and continue to release updates for. I'll definitely miss it...

Which is why I've started another small project in the same style that I'll be announcing soon! It's basically a hugely refined spiritual successor, with a brand new story and cast of characters.

I'm not ready to show it just yet, but I can say that it's about a girl and her dog being hunted down by a witch on New Years Eve! It's called "Like Papercuts." It's probably my favorite game script I've ever written, so I'm really excited about it - and thematically it's about some personal things I went through this year. I'll do another post when the Steam page and demo for it is up, which will hopefully be sometime this year!

Until then,

Jack

notes.title: Update 5 Coming August 23rd!
notes.notes:
The Final Update for Dead Detention - Version 1.5 - will be released in two weeks on August 23rd! (This will be timed with another sale.) You can try the beta version early by selecting the beta branch from the build options!!

My main focus was to improve the Gamepad controls in the microgames, as well as add a final bit of visual polish. Version 1.5 also adds a new unlockable extra called "Microgame Marathon." This mode plays through all the microgames in order with shuffling backgrounds and songs!

You can check out the draft of the patch notes early here on the community forums.

I've also gone through early and updated the Steam page screenshots and trailer showing what the game looks like now after all five updates. 😊😊😊

notes.title: Dead Detention Version 1.4
notes.notes:
Dead Detention Version 1.4 is out now. It includes a new song, a new flashback scene, more arts and crafts theming, plus lots of other tweaks and improvements. It's also 70% off for the next two weeks!


[previewyoutube="Q3t8cPP7--8;full"][/previewyoutube]Patch NotesStronger Arts and Crafts Visual Theming
Paper Plates

Moved some round background scribbles onto paper plates propped up by randomly colored straws.

Some of these plates spin.

Backgrounds

Each time the background changes, random arts and crafts supplies are placed along the edges.

Supplies are also shown randomly around the edges of the screen during scribbles.  (Added in 1.41)

There are now two more backgrounds that might be chosen instead of cardboard; newspaper and a messy table. (Added in 1.41)

Added shadows to the paper sheets. (Added in 1.41)

Character Straws

Characters are now propped up by randomly colored straws taped to them.

More Tape and Pins etc.

Added tape and pins to the receive item window.

Added sticky tape to the vent screws.

Added sticky tape to the loot items.

Added tape to the microgame titles. (Added in 1.41)

Added a pin to the microgame time bar. (Added in 1.41)

Added tape to the episode and transition titles. (Added in 1.41)

Added tape to the end screen title. (Added in 1.41)

Added popsticks behind the end screen buttons. (Added in 1.41)

Character Textures

Some character poses are now on different textures, including newspaper, colored paper, cardboard, and more.
Expanded Soundtrack
New Music

Added a little new song called "Lullaby." (It was written for the flashback added to Episode 5.)

The Steam version of the soundtrack has been updated to include it.
Improved Story
Stronger Emotional Core

Episode 1: The new song plays faintly while Max is sleeping at the start.

Episode 3: Max now hears brief words from his father when he's cornered.

Episode 5: Added a brief flashback to the start of Episode 5 with Max and his father.

Episode 5: The Lullaby song now plays before Max stands up to the boss.

Episode 5: Max hears words from his father when he thinks back to his friends.

General Improvements

Added heavy footsteps to the zombies approaching Max in Episode 1 and 3.

Added a couple more alternative lines throughout the story based on Player choices. (Added in 1.41)

Other minor adjustments to some other sequences to improve flow.
Improved Visuals
General

Lowered the frequency of the paper scraps blowing across the screen slightly.

Episode 1

Replaced the sleeping scribble with the better one from Episode 4 + made it smaller.

Improved the Naomi sneaking up on the zombie scribble.

Improved the Sora killing the zombie scribble.

Episode 4

Improved the Sora crying scribble + made it purple like the other art in the scene.

Episode 5

Improved the Naomi thinking scribbles.

Character Sprites

Improved Naomi's eyes on her idle frame.

Made Dr. Miller's eyes closed on her concerned frame.
Improved Microgames (Added in 1.41)
Added a hammer to the whack-a-mole microgame.

Made the icons in the dragging microgame spawn closer to the goal.

Blocking in the boxing minigame now also rewards a point of progress.

Added an extra second to the confidence microgame.

In normal mode, Episode 1 microgames now have a 1 second bonus.

Changed the opening door microgame back to the clearer original.
Other Tweaks and Fixes
Bug Fixes

Fixed the Boss Rush crashing (whoops!).

Fixed a possible crash in the casino slot microgame. (Added in 1.41)

UI

Added a sound effect when hovering over a story choice.

Thanks so much to everyone who's played so far! If you encounter any bugs or issues, you can report them here. 

More soon,

Jack

notes.title: Dead Detention Version 1.3
notes.notes:
Dead Detention Version 1.3 is out now. This is easily the biggest update yet! It adds stronger arts and crafts visual theming, new visual effects, atmospheric audio, hard mode improvements and better pacing in Episode 5.

The game is also 60% for the next two weeks, and the soundtrack is 20% off.

Patch Notes
More Arts and Crafts Theming
Scissors
 When characters die, they're now cut up by scissors.
UI
 Added sticky tape to window titles, crosses and other elements.
 Added bulletin pins to the morality icon, inventory slots and the episode select.
 Added popsticks to the plot token icons.
 Added staples to the window description box.
 Paper particles spawn from clicks in the title screen, and from buttons in-game.
Transitions
 The black cardboard now tears in and out instead of fading.
Intro
 Redesigned the intro screen to have lots of crafting materials.
Overlay Effects
 Paper particles now spawn and blow around the screen.
 A depth overlay effect scrolls over the screen.
Atmospheric Audio
 Atmospheric audio loops now play in the background beneath the music.
 Loops include: a classroom, fire, a helicopter, night time, wind and bike riding.
Emotion Particles
 Particles will emit from characters where they're showing certain emotions. (ie. skulls when they're bitten.)
Lighting
 A proper lighting system was added, adding a subtle lighting overlay for certain scenes, locations and times of day.
 Added a glow to Dr. Okaby's visor and zombies that are on fire.
Episode 5 Refinement 
Improved pacing
 Sora and Naomi ring the bike's bell when they show Max.
 Max now runs up to Sora before helping her up.
 Added narration of Max and Sora running through the city.
Final Boss Microgames
 Added new sprites for the boxing minigame, showing the final boss.
Visual Refinement 
Scribbles
 Added scribbles and impact lines to Max tripping.
 Improved the colours and lining of Max using his phone.
 Improved the exclamation bubbles on multiple scribbles.
 Several other little tweaks and improvements to the scribbles.
Character Poses: Max
 Made his face goofy when he's yawning or checking his phone.
Character Poses: Naomi
 Improved her face slightly.
 Made her angry when holding the bat.
 Made her eyes closed when smiling or holding the broken bat.
 Made her face goofy when he's shocked.
 Improved her laughing and scared poses.
Character Poses: Dr. Miller
 New eyes.
Character Poses: Ryan
 New eyes.
 Improved closed eyes, and added more shading.
Character Poses: Teacher
 Added an angry frame.
Microgames 
Visuals
 Added crayon textures to more sprites.
Time Limits
 Each individual microgame now has a specific time limit.
 Hard Mode time limits are now tighter.
Controls
 When playing with button/gamepad controls, the cursor now hides when playing all microgames that don't require it.
Fixes
 Fixed a hitstop performing when losing a life in the rhythm minigame that could cause the music to go a touch out of sync with the notes.

Thanks so much for playing, and I hope you like the update! The game feels so much nicer and fun to play now :)

More soon,
Jack

notes.title: Dead Detention Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 of Dead Detention is out now! It features a detailed polish pass across the entire game; mostly focused on refining lots of the visuals. It also features new microgames, more accurate achievement icons, new Steam branding, and other neat improvements. The game is also part of the "Visual Novel Fest" Steam Festival - which just kicked off - and is 40% off for the next two weeks!

Patch Notes
Episode 1
Microgames
 Updated "Thinking 1" microgame: Made the placement of lightning bolts further apart.
 Updated "Running" Boss Minigame: It now only gets faster once, until it repeats in Episode 5.

Visuals
 Added a yellow, patterned background to all the times Max gets an idea.
 Improved the shading on Max when he erases from the blackboard.
 Added heart bubbles to Naomi hugging Sora.
 Made Max fully blue when grabbing Sora.
 When Sora escapes from Max's grasp, Max is now silhouetted, with a different scribble shape.
Episode 2
Microgames
 New Microgame: "Open." A circle grows and shrinks; click at the right time to fill the bar.
 Updated "Targets" Boss Minigame: Added a pattern to the background and made it brighter.
Visuals
 Improved Max grabbing the entrance door + made the zoom in greyscale.
 Added scribbles to the background of Max's smiling/frowning face. It also later zooms in and turns to color, with an added sound effect
 Improved the eyes on the Zombie breaking into the computer lab + set a new scribble outline.
 Improved the "BONK!" text when the zombie is hit.
 Added "SNAP!" text when [spoiler]the bat snaps[/spoiler].
 Added more scribbly outlines [spoiler]when the teacher is bitten[/spoiler].
 Improved the door outline when Max is reaching for the handle + made it greyscale with a glowing yellow key.
 Added shadows to Naomi while grabbing the fence.
Episode 3
Microgames
 Updated "Boxing" Boss Minigame: Improved the sprites of the boxer; made the hurt frame red, redid the charge frames, plus some other tweaks.
Visuals
 The looting scribbles were all refined; the items were repositioned on a higher level + changed the scribble shape + made the background more greyscale.
 Added a scribble pattern to the background of Max's hurt fingers.
Episode 4
Microgames
 Updated "Rhymth" Boss Minigame: Fixed the timing issues introduced in the previous update.
Visuals
 Moved the plot token paper behind the fence.
 Added a scribbly background to Max sleeping + changed the outline shape.
 Replaced Max waking up with a close-up of his eye + extended this sequence with black and white versions of these visuals.
Episode 5
Microgames
 New Microgame: "Dialing 2." Press to shoot a triangle to hit the correct icons.
 New Microgame: "Lift." Complete the puzzle by pressing the pieces to spin them.
 New Microgame: "Running 3." Press the correct colored running icon several times.
Visuals
 When they kill zombies together, the background now turns orange after all the zombies are defeated.
 Improved Naomi's color and outline when using the flamethrower.
 Removed the original scribble of Max holding Sora; it now only shows the pop-stick version, and it raises once Max completes the "Lift" microgame.
 Refined the landed helicopter silhouette; added stars, trees and nicer colors.
Characters
Max
 Added two new crying frames that are used in Chapter 5.
Naomi
 Made her face goofy while she's looking at her phone.
Dr. Okaby
 Made his frown more pronounced.
Other Improvements
Audio
 Some sounds, like for the helicopter, play later once the scribble is fully transitioned in.
 The title theme now fades out first when starting the boss rush.
Achievements
 Added silver, gold and diamond trophy sprites; reflecting the Steam achievement icons.
 These are displayed both on the achievement screen and when popping the achievement.
Menus
 The game now fades out before exiting.
Updated Steam Branding (Note: this change was set live a few weeks early.)
 New zombie-themed Steam branding.
 New soundtrack album art.
 New soundtrack "screenshot." (An album mockup.)

Thanks for playing, and I hope you enjoy the update! You can also check out my much, much, more serious game "Faye Falling" here, plus follow me on twitter (to see when my next game is (finally) announced!) here.

More soon,
Jack

notes.title: Dead Detention Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 of Dead Detention is available now! This first major update features many improvements, fixes and tweaks. The biggest update is the improved performance - which fixed several issues with the texture pages. It plays so much smoother now. Check out the full patch notes below:

Patch Notes
Improved Performance
Many sprite groups have been reorganised, and some larger ones placed onto separate pages, lessening or removing the small load times or freezes when they'd display. These include:
 Characters
 Scribbles
 Microgames
 Windows
 Main Menus
Main Menus
 Changed the new game button to display Naomi instead.
 Updated all the Episode select buttons to display different scribbles that cover the whole sprite.
 An error sound plays when trying to select a locked episode or locked extra.
Character Design Refinement
Max
 Shaded face on closed eyes pose.
 Improved bragging pose.
Sora
 Improved face on bat pose.
 Shaded face on broken bat pose.
Dr. Miller
 Shaded face on closing eyes pose.
Dr. Okaby
 New laser visor design.
 Added a smile pose.
Music
 Increased the volume of the song "Sora's Promise."
 The complete soundtrack is also now available on bandcamp.

Bike Crash Sequence
 A rock on a pop stick now animates in, replacing the original awkward crash scribble.
Final Boss Sequence
 Fixed a continuity error: made the final boss miss their top half instead of their head in their death scribble.
 The "Erase" microgame now repeats as a call back to Episode 1.
Ending Sequence
 Added a line boil animation effect to the Good and Sad ending frames.
End Credits Sequence
 Redesigned the end credits, adding scribbles above each credit.
Trip Sequence
 Max now shakes after tripping in Episode 1.
Rhythm Minigame
 Notes now move and spawn taking the current fps into account.
Scribble Improvements
Episode 1
 New outline for the Max sleeping scribble.
 The zombie Sora kills is now frowning + added a striped background pattern.
Episode 2
 The zombie chasing the group is now making a goofy face + is bleeding from under their shirt.
 Added impact squiggles all around the [spoiler]teacher bite[/spoiler] scribble.
Episode 4
 Animated Max's sleeping scribble + made it black and white, like the intro sleeping scribble.
Episode 5
 Improved Naomi's thinking scribble.
 New Naomi idea scribble.
 When Naomi starts the fire, that whole scribble now turns orange.
Episode 6
 Fixed one of the flashback frames using an old version of a scribble.
 Replaced the carrying flashback frame after the good ending to one with Max and Naomi.
 Improved the grave scribble with added shadows and shading.

Thanks so much for playing!

If you enjoyed this weird little game, make sure to leave a review, too - it really helps with Steam’s algorithm! I'm also planning to release another visual novel game this year, but that one will be much more serious and dark in tone...no goofy scribbles! (And much more blood and death, YAY.)

Happy (late) New Year,
Jack
